title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: A ROC curve plots the true positive rate (TPR) against the false positive rate (FPR) at various threshold settings. The curve helps to visualize the performance of a binary classifier.

title: Thresholds in ROC Curves
text: The thresholds are used to determine the point at which a predicted probability is considered a positive prediction. These thresholds are varied to calculate different TPR and FPR values.

title: Choosing the Correct Expression
text: Which expression correctly converts predicted probabilities to binary predictions based on a threshold?
